description: Template only. Do not add values until measured length, uncertainty and exact endpoint coordinate provenance are all available.

measurementPolicy.splitPolicy: Hold out complete baseline/site groups, not individual adjacent segments.
measurementPolicy.coordinatePolicy: Coordinates must identify the exact monument endpoints and have their own provider/reference. Approximate site-centre coordinates are not acceptable.
measurementPolicy.sourcePolicy: Record measured horizontal distance, its stated uncertainty and the source certificate or dataset row. Never derive distance from coordinates.
